changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Nucleo de la incidencia (ARC-113): alta con referencia unica, sala, categoria, snapshots de denominacion y autor
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE incidencia ( incident_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, reference_code VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) NOT NULL, room_id NUMBER NOT NULL, category_id NUMBER NOT NULL, room_name_snapshot VARCHAR2(120 CHAR) NOT NULL, office_name_snapshot VARCHAR2(120 CHAR) NOT NULL, category_name_snapshot VARCHAR2(60 CHAR) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR2(500 CHAR) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) DEFAULT 'ABIERTA' NOT NULL, reported_by NUMBER NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP(6), version NUMBER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, status_code GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(status AS VARCHAR2(20 CHAR))) VIRTUAL, reported_by_user_id GENERATED ALWAYS AS (reported_by) VIRTUAL, CONSTRAINT pk_incidencia PRIMARY KEY (incident_id), CONSTRAINT uk_incidencia_reference_code UNIQUE (reference_code), CONSTRAINT ck_incidencia_description_len CHECK (LENGTH(description) BETWEEN 10 AND 500), CONSTRAINT ck_incidencia_description_blank CHECK (TRIM(description) IS NOT NULL), CONSTRAINT ck_incidencia_version CHECK (version >= 0), CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_room FOREIGN KEY (room_id) REFERENCES cat_sala (room_id), CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_category FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES cat_categoria_incidencia (category_id), CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_status FOREIGN KEY (status) REFERENCES cat_estado_incidencia (status_code), CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_reported_by FOREIGN KEY (reported_by) REFERENCES usuario (user_id) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Indices de acceso de la bandeja del tecnico y de "Mis incidencias"
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_incidencia_mis_incidencias ON incidencia (reported_by, created_at DESC, incident_id DESC)
